question: What is Diginex

beats.line: Diginex is repositioning itself as one unified sustainability, data and compliance platform.
beats.headline: ONE PLATFORM
beats.action: A halftone paper platform slab lowers onto a cream chip and settles flat, filling the frame.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex is repositioning itself as one unified sustainability, data and compliance platform.

beats.line: Its software and advisory work helps organisations collect, manage and report ESG, climate and supply-chain data.
beats.headline: ESG DATA
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge, then the platform slab tilts and stacked paper documents slide onto it; a cream paper ribbon runs from the platform slab to the stacked paper documents and stays.
beats.delivery: Its software and advisory work helps organisations collect, manage and report ESG, climate and supply-chain data.

beats.line: It is designed to serve banks, asset managers and enterprises.
beats.headline: BANKS, ASSET MANAGERS
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the stacked documents fold upward into three small paper buildings that stand beside the platform slab, the cream ribbon already in place between slab and documents.
beats.delivery: It is designed to serve banks, asset managers and enterprises.

beats.line: Four distinct businesses have been absorbed: Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project and Resulticks.
beats.headline: 4 BUSINESSES
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the paper buildings flatten and slide together into the stack of four folders, which lands beside a paper platform grid; an orange paper ribbon runs from the stack of four folders to the paper platform grid.
beats.delivery: Four distinct businesses have been absorbed: Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project and Resulticks.

beats.line: The one point five billion dollar Resulticks deal is the pivotal move, adding AI driven customer data.
beats.headline: $1.5B
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the stack of four folders opens and its sheets lock into the paper platform grid, which swells to fill the frame; a coin-sized cream tag reading '$1.5B' sits beside the orange ribbon, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: [excited] The one point five billion dollar Resulticks deal is the pivotal move, adding AI driven customer data.

beats.line: By early September, the stock trades at one dollar sixteen, with a market cap near thirty-four million.
beats.headline: $1.16 / $34M
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the platform grid folds into the paper bar chart, whose bars drop low on open ground; a black paper string runs from the paper bar chart to a torn paper strip.
beats.delivery: By early September, the stock trades at one dollar sixteen, with a market cap near thirty-four million.

beats.line: Administrative expenses rose three point four million dollars, reaching eight point one million.
beats.headline: G&A $8.1M
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the paper bar chart's tallest bar stretches upward and the torn paper strip unrolls beneath it; a coin-sized cream tag reading '$8.1M' sits beside the black string, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: Administrative expenses rose three point four million dollars, reaching eight point one million.

beats.line: Integration execution is the primary risk, across four businesses and multiple jurisdictions.
beats.headline: INTEGRATION RISK
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the torn paper strip curls up into a paper hand that presses down on the paper bar chart and holds it, the black string still in place.
beats.delivery: Integration execution is the primary risk, across four businesses and multiple jurisdictions.

beats.line: The company has signalled a focus on Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market.
beats.headline: $77B BRAZIL
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the pointing hand flattens into a paper map that unfolds beside the returning platform slab; a lime paper arrow runs from the paper map to the platform slab.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] The company has signalled a focus on Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market.

beats.line: For now this is a higher-risk, speculative position, suited to investors with patience.
beats.headline: SPECULATIVE
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the paper map folds down onto the platform slab, which settles alone on open ground with the lime arrow now pinned across it.
beats.delivery: For now this is a higher-risk, speculative position, suited to investors with patience.
